summary: Learn warehouse design, ingestion, data quality and analytics foundations. Build practical artefacts for your next warehouse project.
lede: Data warehouse training helps data analysts, junior data engineers and warehouse administrators plan reliable analytical data flows. Learners practice mapping source-to-target transformations, planning batch and change-data capture, comparing dimensional and Data Vault models, defining quality checks, documenting lineage and reviewing query patterns. Practical exercises include warehouse diagrams, data dictionaries, quality scorecards and an improvement roadmap.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who work directly with analytical data flows, warehouse structures or the reporting that depends on them. It suits foundation-level learners building a practical grounding in big data analytics and warehousing.
modules: SQL Ingestion and Change Data Capture
SQL Query Plans and Warehouse Serving
prerequisites: Basic familiarity with tabular data and routine spreadsheet use is expected. No programming is required; basic SQL familiarity is useful but not essential. Exercises focus on design artefacts, data-flow logic and introductory query review rather than production deployment.
